paragraphs: Rabbi Yehoshua ben Dama: in the Jerusalem Talmud, Avodah Zarah, chapter 2, a snake bit him. Yuchasin, in the sequence of tannaim, writes that Rabbi Elazar ben Dama died of a snakebite—see his entry—and perhaps the one who died of a snakebite was Rabbi Yehoshua ben Dama. So too Yuchasin, in the sequence of generations under Rabbi Elazar ben Dama, writes that the Jerusalem Talmud mentions this incident concerning Yehoshua ben Dama. But he testified falsely, for in Avodah Zarah 2:2 the incident concerns Elazar ben Dama, Rabbi Yishmael’s sister’s son.
